title: SMIC sent chipmaking tools to Iran's military, Trump administration officials say — report claims exchange began a year ago, 'almost certainly included technical training on SMIC's semiconductor technology' | Tom's Hardware
summary: China's largest chipmaker, SMIC, reportedly provided chipmaking tools and technical training to Iran's military, potentially violating U.S. sanctions. This comes amidst reports of Iran's deal with China on anti-ship cruise missiles and the U.S. naval force deployment near Iran.
sentiment_reason: The article presents negative market impact due to potential violations of U.S. sanctions and the geopolitical tension surrounding the U.S.-Israel conflict and Iran's military activities.
